name: Lehabim
title: Peoples descended from Mizraim
summary: Lehabim was one of the peoples descended from Mizraim (Egypt) in the table of nations. The name is often linked to the Libyan peoples west of Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the table of nations
keyEvents.description: Lehabim is listed among Mizraim's descendants in the genealogy of Ham.
